{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democratic Socialists of America (DSA) condemns the 5-4 Supreme Court decision in Shelby County v. Holder.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Supreme Court decision in Shelby County v. Holder threatens four decades of gains in the protection of voting rights and rights to representation of citizens of color.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Hundreds of thousands of civil rights activists put their lives on the line to win the expansion of the suffrage.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DSA views the fight to overturn the Supreme Court decision as part of a larger struggle to restore democracy to the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports placing strict limits on the role of money in politics.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports providing an expeditious path to citizenship for undocumented immigrants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"DSA supports enacting a constitutional right to vote and to be fairly represented.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"An almost exclusively white Republican Party is turning to undemocratic means to maintain political power.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The court’s decision has already accelerated reactionary efforts to limit the franchise by means of restrictive voter ID laws, elimination of early voting, gerrymandering, and felony exclusion.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republican attorney generals in Texas, Alabama, South Carolina and Mississippi stated that they would immediately institute restrictive voter ID laws and gerrymandering schemes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Restrictive voter ID laws and gerrymandering schemes might have been overturned by the now-gutted enforcement procedures of the Voting Rights Act.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
